labels: AI by-eye labels (WP3 part 2), test video: scoring only
rule: as for the dev clip: event frame = first frame whose centre shows the other side of the surface; crossing = frames in between (foam / water sheet). Drone-drop moments: release = first frame where the tag has visibly separated from the drone's release mechanism; hit = first frame of the impact jolt / splash; settled = first frame after the entry from which the view stays steady with no entry bubbles.

windows.how: every 15th frame (2 per second) looked at as grids

on_drone.note: tag hangs under the drone, camera looking down-and-out past the drone's landing gear and release; sea and horizon far below; drone parts fill the top third of the frame

release.note: release mechanism opens at f2722, tag clear of the drone parts from f2723; drone parts leave the top of the frame by f2727

falling.note: sky and horizon, view drifts slowly; about 0.8 s of fall

hit.note: impact jolt: a splash sheet across the lens at f2747, then the view tilts and stays fixed relative to a dark curved surface at the bottom of the frame (the whale's back), with whitewater and the whale's blow / spray in view at lens height (f2748-f2790)

drone_drop.hit_or_miss: hit. Evidence in the picture: after f2747 the view is fixed to a dark rounded body at the bottom edge and moves with it, a blow / spray rises in front (f2752-f2790), then the camera is carried under water in one smooth dive (f2791-f2800) and from then on the textured back stays fixed at the bottom of every frame, with the whale surfacing again later (f14272: back in air with a blow). A miss would show the tag bobbing at the waterline with no fixed body in view and no carried dive; a floating tag would show the sky/water line slopping across the lens.

settled.note: entry froth gone, steady blue view with the back at the bottom (judged on every 10th frame; about +-10 frames)

events.note: f2790 last frame with sky at the centre (foam rising over the lens); f2791-f2795 water sheet / foam; f2796 first frame with the water column at the centre

outside_windows_seen_in_sample.note: sampled frame in air (a surfacing near 476 s); not stepped through
